title: Guest Services Directory — The Grand Hotel
location: General Access Terminal — The Grand Hotel, Upper City
author: Grand Hotel Guest Services
content:
WELCOME TO THE GRAND HOTEL — BLACKSAND CITY

The Grand Hotel is pleased to receive you.

We are the finest establishment on Theev, and we are aware that the competition is not stiff. We nonetheless take pride in our standard of service.

Guests are reminded that the Grand Hotel operates exclusively under the Law of the Lords. Weapons may be carried but not discharged. Disputes may be conducted but not violently. Conduct that embarrasses our other guests will result in ejection. Conduct that embarrasses us significantly will result in something worse.

Amenities:
— Private dining suites (bookable in advance)
— Secure communications (encrypted, not monitored — or so we tell everyone)
— Medical services (discreet, no questions, additional fee applies)
— Currency exchange (we accept most things of value)

A note to our Imperial visitors: You are welcome here. We ask only that you do not make your affiliation obvious. Certain other guests find it distracting.

A note to everyone else: The same applies in reverse.

Enjoy your stay.

content:
CURRENT GUEST REGISTER — CONFIDENTIAL

Room 7: Admiral Darokyn. Suite. Long-term occupancy. Staff instructed to address him by title and not to ask questions about the naval uniform.

Room 9: Representative of the Murghen Consortium. Name withheld by request. Has received four visitors since arrival. Meetings have averaged ninety minutes each.

Room 12: 'Gesh.' Registered as an independent trader. Has been asking questions about recent arrivals. We are logging his inquiries as a matter of policy.

Room 15: Vacant. Held on standing reservation. Name on reservation: REDTHANE. Reservation has not been claimed in several months. Reservation fee continues to be paid remotely. We do not ask by whom.

title: Grand Hotel — Surveillance Blind Spot Override
location: General Access Terminal — The Grand Hotel, Upper City
author: Grand Hotel Security Systems — Administrative Node
content:
The Grand Hotel operates a full-coverage internal surveillance network. All common areas, corridors, and dining rooms are monitored continuously.

The system allows zone-by-zone override for authorized maintenance. A 12-minute window can be opened before auto-restore detects the loop.

[INTERACTIVE TERMINAL — AWAITING INPUT]

lines: >> GRAND HOTEL SECURITY — SURVEILLANCE MANAGEMENT v3.2
>> ZONE A — Main Lobby & Entrance (6 cameras)
>> ZONE B — Guest Corridors, Floors 1-3 (8 cameras)
>> ZONE C — Rose Pavilion & Private Dining (4 cameras)
>> ZONE D — Service Passages & Staff Access (5 cameras)

options: ZONE C — Rose Pavilion & Private Dining
ZONE D — Service Passages & Staff Access

lines: >> INJECTING LOOP FEED — LAST 30 SECONDS OF CLEAN FOOTAGE
>> AUTO-RESTORE TRIGGERS AT FAILOVER — NO MANUAL EXTENSION POSSIBLE
>> NOTE: STAFF ROUNDS CONTINUE ON STANDARD SCHEDULE.
>> !! CAMERAS ARE BLIND. STAFF ARE NOT. !!

on_complete.message: The selected zone's cameras freeze on their last frames. A looped feed now plays for anyone watching the monitoring station — the corridor or dining room appears quiet and empty. You have twelve minutes before the failover system detects the inconsistency. The hotel staff still walk their rounds on schedule. The cameras are blind. The staff are not.

on_failure.message: OVERRIDE REJECTED. Surveillance feeds remain active. Anomalous access attempt flagged for security review. Hotel management has been notified.

title: Rose Pavilion — Reservation Notice
location: General Access Terminal — The Grand Hotel, Upper City
author: Rose Pavilion Reservations
content:
THE ROSE PAVILION

Blacksand City's finest dining establishment. Private booths available for parties of two to eight. Booth soundproofing guaranteed. Staff discretion absolute.

Reservations recommended. Walk-ins accepted if the party is sufficiently notable.

Current reservations on file:
— Admiral Darokyn holds a standing reservation at his preferred table. He dines most evenings. He occasionally receives guests. If you have business with the Admiral, the Rose Pavilion is his preferred venue for that sort of thing.

— A private booth has been reserved for this evening under a name we are not authorized to share. The reservation includes a request that the booth remain unsurveilled. We have honored this request. We always do.

Note: The Rose Pavilion does not ask what is being discussed in its private booths. We do not want to know. This is not an invitation to tell us.

title: Cliff District — Procurement Listings
location: General Access Terminal — The Grand Hotel, Upper City
author: Cliff District Consortium — Anonymized Listings
content:
CLIFF DISTRICT — CURRENT PROCUREMENT LISTINGS

Note: All transactions conducted through intermediaries. No direct contact with vendors. All items sold as-is, no warranty, no Imperial compliance documentation.

—

LOT 1: Military-grade accelerator rounds, 500 units. Origin unlisted. Condition: New.
LOT 2: Portable communications jammer. TL12. Slight casing damage. Functional.
LOT 3: Psionic suppression field emitter. Condition: Unknown. Vendor notes: 'Do not turn it on inside.' Reason for note: unspecified.
LOT 4: Mercenary services — Murghen Consortium. Eight-week minimum contract. Rates on application. Approximately 900 personnel available.
LOT 5: Navigation data, three restricted systems. Acquisition method: unspecified. Accuracy: claimed 98%.
LOT 6: One (1) item recovered from a derelict in Foreven Sector. Vendor describes it as 'a fragment of something dark. Glassy. Pulses faintly when near electronics.' No further description available. Vendor has requested the item leave their possession as soon as possible. Price: negotiable. Vendor's emphasis: immediately.

—

'Going off the cliff' means you are dealing in things the Imperium would prefer did not exist. Everyone here already knows that.

title: Concierge Advisory — Private Salon Routing
author: Senior Concierge Nera Voss
content:
Upper city guests keep asking for "private dining" when what they actually want is meetings without names attached. We route those parties through the Rose Pavilion service corridor and bill everything to floral maintenance.

Two off-world crews booked mirrored slots this week and never crossed paths. One arrived polished and diplomatic; the other wore dock grime and spoke like belt salvage crews. Both asked about available pilots and temporary registry counsel.

[[redacted diff=9 skill="Broker" attempts=2]]
If either crew asks for the "Moonglass Room," deny politely once, then offer "Cliff Tea Service" instead. That's the phrase chain that moves them to unlogged booths with jammer glass.[[/redacted]]

Please stop letting armed guests use the west lift. Last incident cost us three chandeliers.
